The main takeaway from our work is that
the isospin asymmetries of nuclear matter can be described by the same phenomenological model as that of symmetric nuclear matter.
the density dependence of Esym(ρ) is not a free parameter in the MID model, but it is determined by the parameters of the EOS of symmetric nuclear matter.
